meta.method: WebSearch + WebFetch. confirmed:true only where the figure was read on the cited page itself by WebFetch (or, for PDFs, from text extracted from the fetched PDF). confirmed:false means the figure came only from a search-engine summary or from a page that quoted it second-hand; it is recorded with its source so it can be checked, never as an estimate.
meta.currency_note: Figures are in the local currency of the place: USD (New York, Los Angeles, New Haven), GBP (London), EUR (Dublin), CAD (Toronto, Vancouver), MXN (Mexico City).
meta.price_convention: Most service businesses publish 'from' / 'and up' / '+' prices; those qualifiers are kept in the figure text.
